description: This file is a C source code file implementing CCSP base API functions for device management and communication over D-Bus and RBUS. It includes functions for resource management, parameter getting/setting, attribute management, and table row operations, with support for both internal mechanisms and remote invocation via RBUS. The code handles various operations related to parameters, including wildcards, attributes, and table rows. It also manages dependencies and external resources.
